svg.title: Shared review transaction and response
svg.desc: A role-authorized same-origin request enters a bounded transaction. Membership and owned run are locked. The expected version must match before state and an audit event commit together. Conflicts and uncertain responses preserve the draft.

text.tspan: A timeout or lost response can leave commit outcome uncertain.
The draft stays visible, reload server state before retrying.

svg.text: Rollback, access denied or run not found
